svg.title: RAJ LAB — tensile deformation and vacancy diffusion
svg.desc: Solid bright RAJ LAB lettering with soft dimensional shading. The ribbon keeps its single-center grain growth and horizontal tensile extension. A camera zoom selects a yellow grain near the center and reveals its atomic lattice. All atoms match the yellow grain; seven vacancies migrate through seventy nearest-neighbor atom hops. The camera then zooms out to the same polycrystalline ribbon before crystal formation restarts. Transparent background; seamless seventeen-second loop; reduced-motion still.
